business_summary: Aarnav Fashions Limited engages in the manufacture and trade of textiles in India and internationally. The company provides shirting, suiting, quilts, dohars, bed and fitted sheets, and duvet cover textiles, as well as kid's and women's wears. It sells its products through retail stores. The company was formerly known as Kayel Securities Limited. Aarnav Fashions Limited was founded in 1980 and is based in Ahmedabad, India.
